summary: Iteration 20: Tested 'Edit EMI Payment' feature. 17/17 backend tests PASS + full frontend E2E verification. Admin can edit paid EMI entries via PATCH /api/loans/{loan_id}/payments/{emi_month}. Delhi illaka (id: 69c78cf96781e1fb0d95f0dd) has latest_closing_ym='2024-03'; entries ≤ 2024-03 are correctly locked (403). Muneem correctly blocked for non-current months. EditEmiModal fully functional with pre-filled fields and success toast.

feature_tests.paid_rows_have_emi_paid_amount: PASS — All paid rows have emi_paid_amount > 0
feature_tests.paid_rows_have_emi_paid_date: PASS — All paid rows have emi_paid_date field

feature_tests.admin_edit_closing_month_2024_03_returns: PASS — 403 for closing month 2024-03 in Delhi
feature_tests.muneem_edit_current_month_passes_role_ch: PASS — Muneem editing 2026-03 → not 403 (role check passed)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend PATCH /loans/{id}/payments/{emi_month}: year-closing lock check runs before schedule lookup — correct order (role check → lock check → schedule → paid check)
Frontend canEditRow logic correctly uses row.emi_month > latestClosingYm for admin/maalik and row.emi_month === currentMonth for muneem/sipahi
EditEmiModal initializes amount from row.emi_paid_amount || row.emi_amount and date from row.emi_paid_date — correct fallback chain
Old journal entry is deleted atomically before creating new one in PATCH endpoint — correct accounting approach
collections.py correctly includes emi_paid_amount and emi_paid_date (only for paid rows) and latest_closing_ym per illaka
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. TEST_Gyal_Customer2 loan (id: 69c9e294d9e8bef1b31d5afd) in Delhi had a pre-existing paid EMI in 2026-03 (amount=950, date=2026-03-28). All test edits were restored to original values.
